english_text: Every time Madam President speaks on the Basque country , she brings to this House the picture of sadness and pain , which is very regrettable . This is why I systematically join this assembly in mourning the victims - all the victims - of our more than a century-old conflict . We ought to realise that it is not easy to find an exit to one of Europe ' s darkest political tunnels , especially if we stick to the same paths . We must definitely try something new and we , Euskal Herritarrok are eager to give all the help we can .
